'''Ultimate Freedom''' is the second of four releases of [[Virtual Block 7]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 15 December 2010.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 28 cards: 13 Dark Side and 15 Light Side.

== Discrepancies ==
* Printed as Blind Jedi; later released as [[Rahm Kota, Blind Jedi]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json LightLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026183836/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/LightLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Kashyyyk Insurgent Leader; later released as [[Tarfful, Wookiee Insurgent]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="ll" />
* The three Defensive Shields printed in this release are part of [[Virtual Shields]] in the legacy card data.<ref name="dl">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261026183843/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="ll" />
